points.quote: Toggling the mode changes the rendering only. The page content stays in the notes, so it isn't copied or converted.
Edgeless mode adds an `affine:surface` block ... Canvas-native elements are stored in the surface block's `elements` prop.
Canvas-native elements are stored in the surface block's `elements` prop. This is a Boxed `Y.Map`, keyed by element id ... shape, brush, highlighter, connector, text, group, mindmap
Page mode renders the `affine:note` blocks as a linear flow. Edgeless mode ... renders the same notes as movable cards on a canvas.
They are ordinary blocks placed under the surface or the page root, and they carry their own position.
every element and every gfx block has an `xywh` string such as `"[x,y,w,h]"`.
each element and gfx block has an `index` string. It is a fractional-index string, so you can insert between two items without renumbering ... Higher values render on top.

A group element stores `children: Y.Map<boolean>` ... A group's bounds are derived from its children. A frame is a block with `childElementIds` ... It is a frame region that lists the elements inside it.
